titles.romaji: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Tekketsu no Orphans - Urdr Hunt
titles.english: Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans-Urdr Hunt
titles.native: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ ウルズハント

description:
Year P.D. 323. Gjallarhorn's political intervention into the Arbrau central parliament escalated into an armed conflict using mobile suits. The incident was brought to an end by Tekkadan, a group of boys who came from Mars.

News of Tekkadan's exploits has reached the ears of Wistario Afam, a youth born and raised on the Radonitsa Colony near Venus. The planet, which lost to Mars in the contest for development, is a remote frontier planet in which the four great economic blocs show little interest. It is now used only as a penal colony for criminals, whose inhabitants don't even have IDs.

Wistario, who hopes to change the status quo of this homeland, encounters a girl who claims to be the guide to the Urdr-Hunt.

The anime will be available within the homonymous Smartphone Game.
